title: Control Sherpa: SOC2 prep scratch notes
content:
Purpose: quick personal scratchpad while I walk through the control inventory and try to unify evidence paths. Not polished — thinking out loud.

Quick context: we have a good surface for runtime logs and model routing telemetry, but gaps remain around documented review cadences for control owners and a few missing artifact attachments in the evidence bucket. Goal is to get an internal checklist we can hand to Asha / Marco for formalization.

Open assumptions (call these out):
- Scope = Redwood Hosted API + Dedicated control plane (not private on-prem installs).
- User auth flows: Okta SSO + API keys; rotation policy needs confirmation.
- Retention windows: logs 90 days in hot store, 1 year cold (need to confirm for SOC2 requirement interpretation).

Control mapping sketches (very rough):
- CC:ChangeMgmt -> Owner: Platform Eng (Marco). Evidence candidates: RW-change-log (git tags + PRs), release calendar, RFC reviews (CONFLUENCE-TRUST-893). Open: where do infra config drifts live? Which doc enumerates manual emergency change process?
- IA:AccessMgmt -> Owner: Security (Asha). Evidence: Okta groups export, API key issuance logs, IAM policies snapshot. TODO: add example of a revoked API key and dated revoke record.
- LO:Logging & Monitoring -> Owner: SRE. Evidence: logging pipeline diagram, link to logging-alert runbook, sample alert (PagerDuty incident RW-1422). Note: confirm SLA retention vs SOC2 expected retention for audit sample.
- BC:Backup & Recovery -> Owner: Infra. Evidence: backup job logs, restore test notes, recent restore runbook. I think we ran a restore drill in 2025-11 but need the writeup.

Immediate gaps I kept running into when poking artifacts:
1) API key rotation record: we rotate keys but we don't have a central ledger with rotation dates per service. Need a lightweight CSV or Confluence table with service, last-rotated, owner.
2) Onboarding checklist evidence: HR link/outreach that ties new hires to security awareness training. I saw an email thread but not a canonical artifact.
3) Change approval trail for emergency patches: production hotfix PRs are in GitHub, but emergency verbal approvals are in Slack threads; we should capture a standardized postmortem template to formalize approvals.

Notes-to-self / action list: (short)
- [ ] Create 'api-key-rotation.csv' and seed with current services + owners (due: 2026-03-12).
- [ ] Pull a random 30-day sample of auth events (Okta sign-ins) for auditor sample (SRE / security).
- [ ] Find backup restore drill writeup and add link to BC evidence folder.
- [ ] Draft an emergency-change postmortem template and add to CONFLUENCE-TRUST-893 as a section.
- [ ] Confirm log retention policy with observability team; ask whether we can produce a retention policy doc quickly.

Hypothesis: If we provide auditors with a few canonical examples per control (1–2 artifacts + owner contact + dated proof), that will reduce back-and-forth. Aim to convert these scratch artifacts into a single evidence index.

Example artifact map (one-liners)
- api-keys.csv -> shows last-rotated, owner, notes (place in evidence bucket).
- okta-groups-export-2026-02-01.csv -> membership snapshot for sample users.
- rw-release-rfc-2026-01-15.md -> RFC for model-serving change that includes approval comments.
- restore-run-2025-11-07.docx -> backup recovery drill notes + timestamped screenshots.

Questions for Asha (to ping):
- Do we want to include Dedicated control plane within scope for initial Type 2? I think we should for parity but that ups the evidence surface.
- What's the expected auditor sample size for access events? (I suspect 30–60 days).

Random brainstorms to formalize later:
- Lightweight evidentiary index page: one row per control with columns: control id | owner | artifact link | artifact type | sample dates | notes. Exportable CSV.
- Consider small automation: a GitHub Action that, on PR merge, appends an entry to a 'change-log-evidence' file with date/author/PR link — auto-building the change artifact trail. Low-effort and reproducible.

Slack snippets / links I found while hunting: (put here so I don't forget)
- slack: #platform-ops thread 'hotfix approval - 2026-02-04' (search key: hotfix-2026-02-04)
- jira: RW-3421 covers 'rotate kafka credentials' (linked to infra PR)
- confluence: CONFLUENCE-TRUST-893 is the draft control inventory page I edited last week

Final quick thought: prioritize small reproducible artifacts auditors can click through. Less polished but traceable beats overlong prose. Will turn this into a cleaned checklist and hand off to Asha for owner confirmation.

-- Kyler

(If I don't come back to this in a week: create evidence index skeleton and schedule 30m sync with Asha + Marco)
